tab.no_session_body: Git shows a chat's checkout. Open it from a chat's panel.

scope.label: What changed
scope.working_about: Since the last commit, staged or not
scope.branch_about: Everything since this branch left its base
scope.turn_about: What this chat's last turn changed

head.ahead_of: {n, plural, one {# commit} other {# commits}} ahead of {base}

state.commit_to_finish: Commit to finish it, once every file is as it should be.

conflicts.title: {n, plural, one {# file has conflicts} other {# files have conflicts}}
conflicts.body: Resolve each in your editor, stage it, then commit.

diff.binary: A binary file: no lines to show.
diff.cut: This diff is long: the rest isn't shown.
diff.pick_body: Choose a file to see what changed in it.

empty.working_ahead: Everything on {branch} is committed. {n, plural, one {# commit hasn't} other {# commits haven't}} been pushed.
empty.turn_body: The chat's last turn left every file as it was.

push.pushing: Pushing {n, plural, one {# commit} other {# commits}} to {where}

commit.files: Commit {n, plural, one {# file} other {# files}}

discard.title_many: Discard changes to {n, plural, one {# file} other {# files}}?
discard.body: They go back to the last commit, and a new file is deleted. This can't be undone.

branches.label: Branch
branches.new_body: From {from}, with your changes carried over.
branches.name: Branch name

history.head: {n, plural, one {# commit} other {# commits}} on {branch}
history.empty_body: This branch's first commit will show here.
history.pick_body: Choose a commit to see what it changed.
history.no_files_body: This commit changes nothing its parent had.
history.found: {n, plural, one {# commit found} other {# commits found}}
history.head_all: {n, plural, one {# commit} other {# commits}} on every branch
history.branch_from: From commit {sha}. Switches to it; your changes come along.
history.ref_more: {n, plural, one {# more ref} other {# more refs}}

offline.title: Can't reach {device}
offline.body: It's offline or asleep. Its changes show here once it's back.

timeout.title: No answer from {device}
timeout.body: It took too long. It may be busy, or its connection slow.

not_installed.title: Git isn't on {device}
not_installed.body: Update Zeron there: Git comes with it.

off.title: Git is off on {device}
off.body: Turn it on there, in Settings → Plugins.

not_approved.title: Git isn't allowed on {device} yet
not_approved.body: Allow it there, in Settings → Plugins.

version_mismatch.title: Another version of Git is on {device}
version_mismatch.body: Update Zeron on both devices so they match.

other_author.title: Another Git plugin is on {device}
other_author.body: Someone else's plugin there has the same name. Remove it there to use Zeron's.

no_service.title: Git can't run on {device}
no_service.body: Its version has no service. Update Zeron there.

not_loaded.title: Git didn't start on {device}
not_loaded.body: Its service failed to load. Settings → Plugins there says why.

old_engine.title: A newer Zeron is needed on {device}
old_engine.body: Update Zeron there to use Git with this chat.

interrupted.title: Git stopped on {device}
interrupted.body: It stopped during the call. Try again.

not_a_repo.title: Not a git repository
not_a_repo.body: This chat's folder isn't in a git repository, so there's nothing to compare.

no_checkout.title: No folder
no_checkout.body: This chat isn't working in a folder.

rejected.title: The branch moved on {remote}
rejected.body: It has commits you don't. Pull them first, then push.

auth.title: {remote} said no
auth.body: git on {device} couldn't sign in to it. Check its credentials there.

network.title: Can't reach {remote}
network.body: {device} couldn't connect to it. Check its network.

nothing_staged.title: Nothing is staged
nothing_staged.body: Tick the files to commit first.

no_identity.title: git doesn't know who you are
no_identity.body: Set your name and email for git on {device} (git config user.name, user.email).

dirty.title: Your changes are in the way
dirty.body: Switching would overwrite them. Commit or discard them first.

pull_conflicts.title: Pulling would conflict
pull_conflicts.body: Your commits and theirs change the same lines. Nothing was changed: merge them in your editor or a terminal.

no_base.title: No base branch
no_base.body: There's no main or master to compare this branch with.

no_turn.title: No turn seen yet
no_turn.body: Changes since a turn show once this chat starts its next one.

detached.title: No branch to push
detached.body: The checkout is on a commit, not a branch. Make a branch first.

bad_name.title: Not a branch name
bad_name.body: Branch names can't have spaces, "..", or end in "/" or ".lock".

exists.title: That branch exists
exists.body: There's a branch by that name already: switch to it instead.

timeout.title: git took too long
timeout.body: It may still be working on {device}. Try again in a moment.

git.title: git couldn't do it
git.body: Git stopped in this chat's folder on {device}. Try again; if it keeps happening, run the same there in a terminal to see all of it.

no_ref.title: There's no branch named {words} here
no_ref.body: Choose another branch to compare with, or fetch to bring it from {remote}.

unsafe_dir.title: Git won't work in this folder
unsafe_dir.body: Git doesn't trust a folder another user owns. On {device}, add it with git config --global --add safe.directory, then try again.

locked.title: Another git command is running here
locked.body: Wait for it to finish, then try again. If nothing is running, remove .git/index.lock on {device}.

home.diff_label: {adds} lines added, {dels} removed: open the branch's changes
